name: Revert to Staging
description: Mirrors the configured stable Staging Knowledge Retention integration back into configured Dev after the user confirms that Dev should be reset.
failedLabel: Failed to revert Dev to Staging

inputFields.label: Dev integration ID
inputFields.description: UUID of the configured Dev Knowledge Retention integration. Must match the trusted Dev connection setting; never use a Prod ID.

inputFields.label: Staging integration ID
inputFields.description: UUID of the configured Staging Knowledge Retention integration. Must match the trusted Staging connection setting; never use a Prod ID.
